recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three young men with high-top fade hairstyles, wearing open plaid flannel shirts over bare chests, set against a textured lavender-blue backdrop. The layout features a prominent, distressed gold-toned logo in a square frame on the left and a secondary horizontal title in a bold sans-serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular composition of subjects with the central figure slightly recessed
Repetition of plaid patterns in red, blue, and white across all subjects
Contrast between the soft, cool-toned background and the warm, textured gold typography
Visual weight anchored by the large square logo on the lower left
coreInvariants: Open flannel shirts revealing bare chests
Distressed, 'grungy' texture applied to the main logo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a medium-shot, waist-up arrangement; the left and right figures are in the foreground, the middle figure is slightly behind.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, framed, distressed gold logo in the bottom-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move to the large logo on the left, then follow the horizontal text across to the right figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, with the subjects filling the frame and the background providing a textured surface.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, mid-tone saturation with soft studio lighting that avoids harsh shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The main logo features a large initial letter stacked above a condensed word, both enclosed in a double-bordered square frame with irregular, chipped edges.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily distressed, condensed display face paired with a cleaner, wider sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Double-lined square frame with distressed edges

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for the logo.
Suitable for the secondary horizontal text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three Black men with 90s high-top fades, wearing open red and blue plaid flannel shirts over bare chests, standing against a mottled lavender-blue studio backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large square frame in the bottom left containing a stacked, distressed gold-colored condensed sans-serif logo. To the right of the frame, add a single line of bold gold sans-serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the logo heavily distressed with a grit texture?
Are the shirts open to reveal the chest?
Is the background a textured lavender-blue?
Is the typography ochre/gold in color?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the typography
Tightness of the high-top fade haircuts
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
The exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Consistent ochre-gold color for all text elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the logo frame is square and double-bordered.
Ensure the flannel patterns do not look AI-distorted.
Verify the high-top fades are distinct and well-defined.
Confirm the lavender background has a subtle mottled texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s Urban Portrait + Plaid Flannels + Lavender Backdrop + Distressed Gold Condensed Type
